meta.name: obsidian
meta.description: Work with Obsidian vaults (plain Markdown notes) and automate via obsidian-cli.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化管理 Obsidian 笔记库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Obsidian 管理笔记并想自动化操作。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Obsidian for notes and want to automate tasks.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以读取你的 Obsidian 笔记库配置，搜索、创建、移动、删除笔记，并自动更新笔记间的链接。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 操作 Obsidian 笔记（如搜索、创建、移动笔记）时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索 Obsidian 里包含“会议”的笔记
在 Obsidian 的“工作”文件夹下新建一篇笔记，标题为“周报”
say.note: Claude 会创建笔记并可选打开。

say.text: 把 Obsidian 中的“旧笔记”移动到“归档”文件夹
say.note: Claude 会移动笔记并更新内部链接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read your Obsidian vault configuration, search, create, move, and delete notes, and automatically update links between notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to operate on Obsidian notes, such as searching, creating, or moving notes.

say_en.text: Search my Obsidian vault for notes containing 'meeting'
say_en.note: Claude will use obsidian-cli to search note names and content.

say_en.text: Create a new note titled 'Weekly Report' under the 'Work' folder in Obsidian
say_en.note: Claude will create the note and optionally open it.

say_en.text: Move the note 'Old Note' to the 'Archive' folder in Obsidian
say_en.note: Claude will move the note and update internal links.
